programme.desc: In this episode of Age Defiantly host Mark Young is joined by Dr Melissa Grill-Petersen a global pioneer in precision health co-founder of Peptide University and creator of the BioHouseMan framework Moving past the myopic theories of lifespan Dr Grill-Petersen pulls back the curtain on the massive often dangerous research use only underground market to discuss the true clinical reality of cell-signaling molecules She challenges the dangerous more is better standard protocol pushed by pharmaceutical giants advocating instead for the targeted pulsatile use of low-dose and micro-dose peptide therapies to safely toggle the body away from sympathetic stress and chronic inflammation Mark and Dr Grill-Petersen dive deep into the pervasive use of GLP-1 agonists framing them not as a permanent shortcut to weight loss or an enabler of bad behavior but as a temporary behavioral pause button to correct deep-seated issues like severe food noise and metabolic dysfunction Emphasizing that powerful signaling sequence instructions are only as effective as the biological terrain they inherit Dr Grill-Petersen explains how to mitigate genetic risk factors protect the gut from low-motility toxicity and master basic circadian inputs like light exposure and restorative sleep to transition away from fear-based aging and fully embrace what it means to step into your timeless potential

programme.title: BiohackingVille - When AI Plays Doctor Horror Stories the 6 Tools Im Testing So You Dont Have To
programme.desc: Host Rob Rene discusses the risks of using AI chatbots for health advice warning that authoritative-sounding answers can be dangerously wrong due to “garbage in garbage out” weak judgment and frequent omissions He cites horror stories including a 60-year-old man who replaced table salt with sodium bromide after ChatGPT advice and was hospitalized and notes reported triage and diagnostic error rates including high pediatric error Rob argues healthcare is moving rapidly toward personalized medicine using genetics bloodwork and sensors while emphasizing urgent care strengths of modern medicine and his own near-death and stage III melanoma experience He previews tests of six popular tools ChatGPT Ada Health Oura Ring Wysa InsideTracker Viome stresses health sovereignty and guardrails and shares his approach of cross-checking multiple AI systems favoring Grok and Brighteonai for research
